description: Start a real backend with no account and no bearer token: a temporary project (deleted after about 72h unless claimed). Returns connection details, an agent token to use as the bearer for every other tool, and a claim_url. Show the person the `keep.hint` line at once: only a person can claim the project (sign up, same URL and keys). With a bearer token, use projects_create instead.

name.description: Project name, e.g. `todo-app` (lowercase letters, digits, hyphens). Optional.

name: projects_start
title: Start without an account
